tagline: Powering the communities we serve through rate-regulated infrastructure investment
hero_kpi_rationale: The rate base is the primary growth driver for regulated utilities like Ameren, as it determines authorized revenues through regulation and reflects investments in energy infrastructure.
company_description: Ameren Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a public utility holding company in the United States. The company operates through four segments: Ameren Missouri, Ameren Illinois Electric Distribution, Ameren Illinois Natural Gas, and Ameren Transmission. It engages in the rate-regulated electric generation, transmission, and distribution business and natural gas transmission and distribution business. The company also generates electricity through coal, nuclear, and natural gas, as well as renewable energy, including hydroelectric, wind, methane gas, and solar energy centers. It serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers. Ameren Corporation was founded in 1881 and is headquartered in Saint Louis, Missouri.

kpis.name: Rate Base
kpis.explanation: Value of regulated assets on which the company is allowed to earn a regulated return.
kpis.description: The rate base grows steadily through investments in transmission, distribution, and generation, supporting growth in regulated revenues.
kpis.signal: Sustained rate base growth driven by regulated infrastructure investments.

kpis.name: Allowed ROE
kpis.explanation: Regulator-approved return on equity for regulated assets.
kpis.description: Allowed ROE varies by segment: 10.48% for Ameren Transmission, 8.72% for Illinois Electric, 9.60% for Illinois Gas.
kpis.signal: High ROE on transmission, the most profitable segment.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and direct costs, expressed as a percentage of revenues.
kpis.description: Gross margin is stable and high, typical of regulated utilities with cost recovery mechanisms.
kpis.signal: High gross margin due to regulation and cost predictability.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenues.
kpis.description: Operating margin is slightly improving due to disciplined cost management.
kpis.signal: Improving operational efficiency despite the regulated environment.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Annual spending on new assets or infrastructure improvements.
kpis.description: Sustained capital expenditures aim to enhance grid reliability and meet decarbonization goals.
kpis.signal: Capex rising significantly to modernize the grid and integrate clean energy.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount is slightly decreasing due to automation and process optimization.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in headcount despite rate base growth.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $8.799 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.523 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2017).

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.75 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.768 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Revenue Requirement Increase
kpis.explanation: Additional amount authorized to be charged to customers following a rate case review.
kpis.description: In April 2025, the MoPSC approved a $355 million increase in revenue requirement for Ameren Missouri, effective June 2025.
kpis.signal: Clear regulatory recognition of past investments.

kpis.name: Future Test Year
kpis.explanation: Regulatory change allowing the use of future data to set rates.
kpis.description: The PPRA allows Ameren Missouri to use a future test year for gas rates starting July 2026.
kpis.signal: Modernization of the regulatory framework to better align investments and recovery.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income distributed as dividends. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: EPS
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).
